transcript.content: Hello, it's nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

Nice to meet you too. Basically, I'm here because I just can't seem to keep my mind on one thing anymore. 

I'm a software developer, and lately, I'll be right in the middle of fixing a rendering bug... and then a Slack ping will go off, or I'll notice a specific color pattern on my screen, or even just hear a siren outside. And it just completely pulls me into a whole new idea before I can even finish typing the line of code. It's making it really difficult to get anything done.
When this happens, are you also feeling unusually energized or wired?

Yeah, I do. "Wired" is a pretty good word for it. It's like I've been running on this constant current lately. 

I'll wake up and my brain is already just going—planning out new features, uh, exhibition layouts, press angles, code changes... it's all just happening right away. Honestly, just sitting still feels like I'm wasting the moment.
Have you been needing less sleep than usual and still feeling rested?

I haven't really noticed a change with that, to be honest. I mean... I still try to get my usual six or seven hours. I wouldn't say I'm sleeping less than normal, or, you know, running on empty but feeling fine. I'm pretty sure my sleep schedule is about the same as it usually is.
During these times, do you feel unusually euphoric or especially irritable?

Yeah, I'd say both, actually. Most days lately, I just feel completely lit up. It's this unstoppable feeling, like... like the whole city of Glendale has finally caught up with what I've been building all this time. Everything just makes sense and feels amazing. 

But, uh, on the flip side... I get really irritable if people get in my way. Like, I'll snap pretty hard at my wife, or my coworkers, if they try to slow me down with their questions or what they call "process." It just feels like they're dragging their feet when I'm ready to run.
Lately, have you felt more important, gifted, or powerful than usual?

Yeah, I suppose I have. I mean, I honestly feel like I'm the only one who can really do what I'm doing right now. It's like... I'm the only person who can connect generative art, Mexican visual traditions, and the tech community all together. I really believe doing it this way could completely change how the city sees public art. So, yeah, I guess that does make me feel pretty important, or at least uniquely capable of pulling this off.
Have you been taking on a lot more projects or activities than usual lately?

Yeah, definitely. I've been taking on a lot. I mean... I've been emailing curators, pitching to community leaders... I'm also rewriting the backend, mock-planning the physical installations, and, uh, trying to recruit other developers at all hours. It's just... this whole project feels way bigger than my regular job right now, so I'm putting everything I have into it.
How many days in a row have you been feeling this unusually energized and driven?

Well, it's been a lot more than just a few days. Um... I'd say this has been going on for about three months now. Yeah, it started right around the time my platform was selected for the Glendale showcase, and I've just been going non-stop ever since.
Has this period caused serious problems in your life, like major trouble at work or in your marriage?

Yeah, I mean... it has. At work, they actually put me on leave. I, uh, I bypassed the usual approval process and just deployed some changes on my own. I just wanted to get it done, but they obviously weren't happy about it. 

And at home... it's been pretty rough, too. My wife says that all the money I've been spending on the project and the arguments we keep having... she told me it's made things feel really unstable between us. So, yeah, it's definitely causing some major issues.
